reasoning: On the season so far the Knicks are the stronger team; with home court the Knicks start about 3 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Heat.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Knicks win 53 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 201 and 249 total points.
